purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian retail pricing system - Cadastro de Preco Pontual (Spot Price Registration) for managing customer-specific product prices with validity periods, minimum prices, and ICMS tax calculations
purpose.summary: This program manages spot/special pricing (Preco Pontual) for retail customers in a Brazilian distribution/wholesale system. It provides CRUD operations (list, include, alter, delete, save) for customer-specific product prices with validity date ranges. It integrates with commercial manager, network/chain, product, client, pricing tables, ICMS taxation, and corporate entity data.

notable_features: 62 COPY statements for modular file/record definitions
Brazilian Portuguese comments and field names
Line sequential file for spreadsheet/CSV export
Multiple pricing tables: minimum price, spot price, ICMS taxation
